output.reason: The brief ties the shortfall to CR-118, which was logged as a label change but actually changed the premium window, and backs this with a full recalculation in which the 22:00 starters were paid correctly and a re-run reconciled all 158 night workers. That fits the ticket pattern far better than Ardentra's data story, and the recommended actions are clear and sensible, though I have to take the audit-trail and recalculation evidence on trust.
